visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins with a close-up of a blue traffic directional sign for Atami Port and Ito under a bright, clear sky. A hand holds a small plastic Crayon Shin-chan figure in the foreground, moving it slightly. The camera then cuts to a close-up of a paper brochure featuring the word 'ATAMI' in blue letters and a local phone number, with the same figure positioned nearby. (2) A man with black hair and glasses, wearing an off-white button-down shirt and grey trousers, runs onto a modern balcony overlooking a calm sea and a harbor. He begins a rhythmic, energetic dance, performing high-kicks and punching motions with a determined facial expression. He holds a transparent plastic water bottle in his right hand. (3) A series of rapid cuts shows a red and black 'Yakiniku' banner flapping in the wind, followed by the empty wooden stage of a traditional Japanese theater with rows of dark seats. The man is then seen eating crispy fried shrimp tempura and dipping long soba noodles into a cup of sauce with chopsticks, closing his eyes in enjoyment. (4) A fast-paced montage depicts the man dancing in numerous locations: a sunny seaside plaza, in front of a classical green bronze statue, on a deserted road with lush hills, inside a building featuring a giant colorful kaleidoscopic ceiling, and on a stone-paved path. Each cut shows him performing the same specific dance sequence. Nighttime shots of massive, brilliant fireworks displays over a dark crowd are interspersed. (5) The man stands outside a building marked 'MUSEUM ENTRANCE'. He appears nervous, clutching the water bottle to his chest and talking animatedly with exaggerated facial expressions. Another person's hand enters the frame and strikes the water bottle, causing it to fly out of his hands and disappear from view as he looks on in shock.
